svg.title: Underground miner — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as underground miner, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A long pointed mining pick is separate above an angular ore-loaded cart with two clearly visible wheels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
